project_type: Monorepo with pnpm workspaces, Turbo, Next.js 16 apps, Node.js 20.x services
build_system: pnpm v9.15.4 workspaces with Turbo v2.3.3 pipeline orchestration. Build outputs to .next/ (apps) and dist/ (packages). Concurrency: 2 (turbo.json). Node memory: 8192MB for builds.
test_framework: Vitest v4.0.18 for unit/integration tests, Playwright v1.62.1 for E2E. Test files: *.test.ts (packages), __tests__/ (packages/apps), tests/e2e/ (root E2E suite). Vitest workspace: vitest.workspace.ts. Test command runs per-package via turbo.
test_command: pnpm test (turbo run test for workspace packages with test scripts)
verification_instructions: Per CONTRIBUTING.md: (1) pnpm lint:all (ESLint with --max-warnings=0, fails on any warning), (2) pnpm typecheck:all (TypeScript strict mode across all apps/packages), (3) pnpm build:all (builds 12 apps). For new packages: add vitest.config.ts, add to vitest.workspace.ts, run pnpm test.
snapshot_or_generated_files: None for M1. Discovery package generates JSON snapshots at runtime (not committed). No codegen.
environment_constraints: Windows environment (e:\onlinewebsites\quiz-platform). Never use forward-only paths. Workspace paths use EITHER forward slashes (tsconfig, package.json) OR backslashes (PowerShell, file operations) consistently per context. Git committed at baseline 516b7bf6.
contribution_requirements: CONTRIBUTING.md: No 'any', strict boolean checks (no truthiness), type/value import separation (@typescript-eslint/consistent-type-imports), no console logs, complexity <20, max-lines 500 warning, no floating promises. Use Drizzle $inferSelect/$inferInsert for DB types. Route handlers: typed request/response, explicit error handling. Fire-and-forget: void fn().catch(). Lint/typecheck/build must pass before commit.
key_patterns: Packages export via src/index.ts with @quiz/* aliases (tsconfig paths). Block types: discriminated unions with 'type' and optional 'version' fields (e.g., CodeC1Block has type='code' + version='C1'). Evidence model: { evidenceId, path, kind, claim, locator, contentHash }. Repository adapters abstract fs/git for testability. Snapshot schema: JSON with canonicalHash (SHA-256 determinism). Validation: schema + integrity checks (V1-V9).
directory_structure: Root: apps/ (12 Next.js apps including skillhubcore-admin), packages/ (21 packages: types, ui, db-tutorial, db-*, auth, validation, observability, etc.), services/ (3 services: api-gateway, skillhubcore-service, analytics-collector-service), tests/ (root E2E), docs/ (governance, phases), ILS_UI_UX/ (architecture docs), .agents/ (task tracking). Block types: packages/types/src/tutorial-rich-document/blocks/. Block renderers: packages/ui/src/tutorial/blocks/. Composer: packages/db-tutorial/src/services/. Project LLM admin: apps/skillhubcore-admin/src/lib/project-llm/.
